Technical Manual

## What this section covers

BNR has three report products. They share publication principles but do not
share one generic analysis dispatcher.

| Product | Current route | Public form |
|---|---|---|
| Rolling three-month CVD update | One controlled build from approved public event and mortality releases | Dated HTML page |
| Annual CVD report | Step 1 builds the report and extracts its final update appendix; Steps 2 and 3 approve and publish both together | Annual PDF, one-page update PDF and separate HTML landing pages |
| One-off CVD report | Bespoke analysis, then Step 1 prepare, Step 2 approve, Step 3 publish | PDF and HTML landing page |

The annual and one-off routes keep candidate preparation, approval and
publication separate. The rolling update is a narrow one-step exception because
it uses already-approved public releases and introduces no new surveillance
metric.

## Run the correct route

- [Build a rolling three-month CVD update](rolling-update.qmd)
- [Build, approve and publish an annual CVD report](annual-report.qmd)
- [Prepare, approve and publish a one-off CVD report](one-off-report.qmd)

The optional [report disclosure screen](one-off-report.qmd#disclosure-screen)
creates private review flags only. It does not apply secondary suppression or
approve a report.
